messages.author: 49d86f7ce970cb8e
messages.subject: October Meeting - Call for topics
parts:
For the October meeting (I was thinking Wed, October 27th if we can
get a decent turnout) I'd like to put out a call for presentation
topics. These can be either topics you would like to see discussed,
or would like to present. To get the ball rolling I'll list a few
topics I'd be interested in.

* R best practices
* Debugging
* Time series - specifically what are the benefits of each time series
package (ts, zoo, xts, etc.)
* ggplot package
* plyr package
* rmetrics
* regexes

Once we get enough input we can pick a topic or two and figure out who
would be willing to present on it. Unfortunately, I'm going to have
to take myself off the presenter list for October since I may have to
skip the October meeting due to a new baby (my wife is due Nov 1).

Regards,
Ed

messages.author: 49d86f7ce970cb8e
messages.subject: Re: October Meeting Details
parts:
Thanks for all the well wishes!  Everyone is doing fine, my new son is 7 lbs 10 oz and doing great.  My wife is recovering much faster than anyone had anticipated.  We should be back at home by end of the day.

I'm going to be running in and out of the hospital for the rest of the day so I won't be able to check email frequently.

If at least 5 people don't express an interest in meeting tomorrow, let's scrap it until early November. In the meantime, I'll plan on setting up a meetup.com account so that we can coordinate this a little better in the future.
